rv.q: Theo Ubique brings a timeless classic new life with a wickedly funny cast. Run, don't walk, to this fantastic show!
Cheers to director Landree Fleming for tapping into her skill, creativity and comic instincts to make this production so fresh and wildly wonderful.

Fleming's vision is certainly helped by Jenna Schoppe's vibrant choreography...Music Director Jeremy Ramey's small band has the sound of one that is much larger, and he and Fleming have every actor in top voice as well...

Of all the theaters whose return I’ve been most excited to experience, Theo Ubique was near the top of the list. And, with their current production of Mary Rodgers’ Once Upon a Mattress, directed by Landree Fleming, the Evanston company did not disappoint.
A Mattress is a fun and light-hearted show filled to the brim with comedy and silly bits.
For most of us, the high production values and verve of the performers offer an inverting that's also wonderfully diverting.

Alan Bresloff 5 years ago [rating=5]It has been quite a while since I have seen a production of "Once Upon A Mattress", with a book by Jay Thompson, Dean Fuller and Marshall Barer and music by Mary Rodgers with lyrics by Marshall Barer.
My enjoyment of Once Upon a Mattress was so sky-high that I was easily able to power through that drawback.
